column3: Lesson three. Better than you, doesn't mean you're worth less.
Episode two hundred and eighty. Goku is fighting the final enemy. Vejeeta can only watch. And silently, he runs the comparison one last time.
He admits it. Kakarot is better. In the original, he calls him number one.
And for the first time, losing the comparison doesn't break him. Because he finally sees it. Goku was never fighting to beat him. He was racing his own limits.

There's some evidence for that second ruler. In a study of nearly six hundred kids and teens, feeling better than your past self brought pride, without the urge to be above everyone else. In adults, the evidence is still thin.
It stops hurting when, they're better, no longer means, I'm worth less.
